folderChanges.commitFailed.description: HI-2944: an error notification's title: Commit of a folder's uncommitted changes (a paused merge, a start's warning, Files' Commit it) was refused.

folderChanges.committed.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {Committed # file} other {Committed # files}} on {branch}.
folderChanges.committed.description: HI-2944: a notification after Commit: the files committed in the folder's branch {branch}.

folderChanges.committedWarning.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {Committed # file} other {Committed # files}} on {branch}, with a warning
folderChanges.committedWarning.description: HI-3059: a warning notification's title after Commit (a paused merge, a start's warning, Files' Commit it): the files were committed in the branch {branch}, but something about git's index (staging area) needs checking afterwards; the text under it says what.

folderChanges.resumed.description: HI-2944: under the notification after Commit or Set aside on a paused merge: the merge queue resumed.

folderChanges.setAside.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {Set # file aside} other {Set # files aside}} on {branch}.
folderChanges.setAside.description: HI-2944: a notification after Set aside: the files stashed in the branch {branch}.

folderChanges.setAsideDetail.defaultMessage: Git keeps them in a stash named "{name}": git stash pop brings them back.
folderChanges.setAsideDetail.description: HI-2944: under the notification after Set aside: where the changes are and how to get them back. {name} is the stash's message. Keep git stash pop as it is: a command.

folderChanges.setAsideFailed.defaultMessage: Could not set the changes aside
folderChanges.setAsideFailed.description: HI-2944: an error notification's title: Set aside of a folder's uncommitted changes was refused.

folderChanges.setAsideWarning.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {Set # file aside} other {Set # files aside}} on {branch}, with a warning
folderChanges.setAsideWarning.description: HI-3059: a warning notification's title after Set aside: the files were stashed in the branch {branch}, but something about git's index (staging area) needs checking afterwards; the text under it says what.

folderChanges.stillPaused.defaultMessage: The merge is still paused: see why on it.
folderChanges.stillPaused.description: HI-2944: under the notification after Commit or Set aside on a paused merge: the queue stays paused (something else still stops it, shown on the paused merge).
